Capacity market: £11,913/MW/year (4h basis), committed data, published 2026-03-12. Method: clearing price per kW of de-rated capacity x 1,000 kW per MW; the stack then multiplies by the storage de-rating factor for the duration. Period: delivery year 2029/30 (T-4 auction held 10 March 2026). Source: Capacity Market T-4 auction for delivery 2029/30 (auction monitor report, Deloitte for DESNZ).

Balancing ancillary: £24,438/MW/year (4h basis), live. Method: mean clearing price of each service over the period, Low + High frequency sides stacked for one symmetric MW, weighted by cleared volume across DC/DM/DR, x 8,760 h, x participation share = mean cleared MW / GB operational battery MW (REPD); same for every duration. Period: delivery 2025-09-28 to 2026-09-28. Source: NESO EAC auction results (Dynamic Containment, Moderation, Regulation).

Wholesale: £80,161/MW/year (4h basis), live. Method: upper bound: perfect foresight, one full cycle per day; per day (mean of the top d hours' price - mean of the bottom d hours' price) x d MWh per MW x round-trip efficiency 0.85, summed over the days; charge and discharge hours are not forced into order. Period: 2025-09-28 to 2026-09-27 (364 complete settlement days). Source: Elexon Insights, Market Index Data (APX), half-hourly GB prices.

Dorking Battery Energy Storage System: 6 MW battery, Operational (as of 2020-07-31), 1.73 km from the site; planning application MO/2016/1168 at Mole Valley. Source: REPD Ref ID 6909, spreadsheet row 5316.

Local precedent exists within 1.73 km via the operational 6 MW Dorking Battery Energy Storage System (repd-6909), and jurisdiction over standalone battery storage schemes of any capacity remains with the local planning authority pursuant to the NSIP carve-out (policy-nsip-carveout). National policy under NPPF Chapter 14 and NPS EN-1 establishes the strategic need for electricity storage to support net zero and grid resilience, with PPG encouraging siting near grid infrastructure alongside appropriate acoustic and landscape mitigation (policy-nppf-14, policy-nps-en1, policy-ppg-renewables). In accordance with NFCC guidance, applications must include a Battery Safety Management Plan detailing thermal runaway mitigation, separation distances, and emergency access provisions (policy-nfcc-safety).
